title: BTC on-chain pulse analytics from our own Bitcoin Core full node — mempool press
description: BTC on-chain pulse analytics from our own Bitcoin Core full node — mempool pressure z-score over 30d, hashrate 7d/30d momentum with trend classification (expanding/stable/contracting), fee regime with 90d percentile rank, UTXO count velocity, SegWit adoption trajectory, difficulty adjustment prediction with hash-ribbon crossover detection. Latency <250ms via Postgres-cached node state. Informational research data — not investment advice.
